items.text: LA Rams (Wed report, walkthrough estimates; Thu report not yet posted): OUT - WR Puka Nacua (knee/toe; MCL/PCL sprains + turf toe, expected IR, ruled out). DNP - CB Trent McDuffie (back, missed Wk9), S Kam Curl (toe), LG Steve Avila (hamstring), TE Terrance Ferguson (ankle/hamstring, likely out a couple more weeks per McVay). Limited - OLB Myles Garrett (knee), TE Davis Allen (oblique), TE Colby Parkinson (ribs), LS Joe Cardona (ankle). IR - WR Davante Adams (hamstring), CB Jaylen Watson, DE Kobie Turner, DT Poona Ford, K Blake Grupe. Matthew Stafford (elbow) full participant, starts.
items.source: Yahoo Sports (Official Cardinals-Rams Week 10 injury report); arizonasports.com

items.text: Arizona (Wed report; Thu report not yet posted): QB Gardner Minshew OUT (feared torn UCL, throwing elbow); Jacoby Brissett traded to BAL. HC Mike LaFleur officially named rookie Carson Beck the starter (first NFL start, so no qb_start override; the model still prices Minshew). Veteran Josh Johnson (11 career starts) signed off CIN practice squad as backup. DNP - C Hjalte Froholdt (concussion), RG Jon Gaines II (ankle), DT Roy Lopez (toe/ankle); rest days for S Budda Baker, G Isaac Seumalo, OLB Josh Sweat, LB Mack Wilson Sr. Limited - LT Jayden Williams (knee), RB Bam Knight (concussion), CB Max Melton (knee/hand), DL Dante Stills (shoulder), S Andrew Wingard (groin); DL Zach Carter and TE Hunter Long back from IR. OUT for season - WR Michael Wilson (neck), WR Kendrick Bourne, LT Paris Johnson Jr. (biceps, IR). OUT - WR Jalen Brooks (wrist). IR - RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle).
items.source: Arizona Cardinals (Injury Report: Week 10 vs Rams); ESPN (Cardinals to start rookie QB Carson Beck)

items.text: Arizona QB: Cardinals signing 40-year-old Josh Johnson (50 games, 11 starts; played for LaFleur with 2021 Jets) after Minshew's injury; Beck remains the named starter for Sunday.
items.source: arizonasports.com (Report: Cardinals signing QB Josh Johnson after injury to Gardner Minshew)
